lines.text: This is Pip. Pip just learned to code. But Pip's *first* *job*... might not be there.
At Anthropic, junior roles fell from *27* *percent* of new tech hires to just *9*.
Over the same stretch, its AI agents were logging *six* *times* as many hours.
Pip! What did a *first* *job* used to look like?
Small bug fixes. Writing tests. The *boring* stuff you *learn* from.
The catch: those small tasks were how beginners *learned*. Nobody knows yet where the *new* *first* *step* will be.
